content.text:
The structure is a PROTAC-like molecule. I read it in sections.

**Left aryl group.** The benzene ring carries a CH2N(CH3)2 group flanked by two OMe groups, and it is attached to the core at its para position. SMILES fragment: c1(CN(C)C)c(OC)cc(cc1OC)-.

**Thieno[3,2-c]pyridinone core.** The thiophene S is bonded to C2 (bearing the carboxamide) and to C7a. C7a is bonded to C7, which carries the aryl group. C7 is bonded to C6H, which is bonded to N-Me, then to C=O (C4), then to C3a, then to C3H, and back to C2. SMILES: c1(C(=O)N...)sc2c(c1)c(=O)n(C)cc2-Ar.

**Amide and spiro amine.** The amide NH is attached to a cyclobutane carbon. The cyclobutane is spiro-fused at the opposite carbon to a piperidine, giving 7-azaspiro[3.5]nonane. The cyclobutane CH is bonded to two CH2 groups, both attached to the spiro carbon. The piperidine nitrogen is N7, and the spiro carbon has two CH2CH2 arms leading to it. SMILES: NC1CC2(C1)CCN(CC2)CCN...

**Linker and imide end.** An ethyl linker leads to a piperazine N. The other piperazine N is attached to the isoindoline-1,3-dione at position 5, and the imide N carries the 2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl group.

**Full SMILES.**
CN(C)Cc1c(OC)cc(cc1OC)-c1cn(C)c(=O)c2cc(C(=O)NC3CC4(C3)CCN(CC4)CCN3CCN(CC3)c3ccc4C(=O)N(C5CCC(=O)NC5=O)C(=O)c4c3)sc12

Ring closure check: the core is written as c1cn(C)c(=O)c2cc(...)sc12. Atom c1 is C7, then c is C6, n(C) is N5, c(=O) is C4, c2 is C3a, c is C3, c(...) is C2, s is S, and c12 is C7a, which closes to both C7 and C3a. This is correct.

The isoindoline ring is c3ccc4C(=O)N(...)C(=O)c4c3. The piperazine attaches at c3, followed by c, c, c4 (bearing a C=O), then c4 (the ring-fusion carbon bearing the other C=O), then c3 closes the ring. The attachment carbon is therefore adjacent to the CH that is adjacent to the fusion carbon, which is position 5. This is correct.

SMILES: CN(C)Cc1c(OC)cc(cc1OC)-c1cn(C)c(=O)c2cc(C(=O)NC3CC4(C3)CCN(CC4)CCN3CCN(CC3)c3ccc4C(=O)N(C5CCC(=O)NC5=O)C(=O)c4c3)sc12
